hook: What kind of change took place in each year?

claims.text: Hansard; British Act; Bangladesh 2011 Gazette reproduction

Hansard distinguishes 1905 reorganization from 1911 announced changes; the British Act partitions Bengal in 1947. The 2011 Gazette reproduces Mujibnagar’s 10 April 1971 proclamation, asserting effect from 26 March. These differ from one another; they establish neither Dacca’s 1905 seat nor safe migration.
Do all four selected years represent the same kind of independence event? Administrative changes, partition and an independence proclamation are different classes
